question: Which chapter concludes at this point in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa text?
premises: The colophon names the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa work.
The chapter concerns characteristics of measures and cords and is numbered twenty-second.
inference: This marks the end of the twenty-second chapter on measure and cord characteristics.
plain_english: Thus ends the twenty-second chapter on the characteristics of measures and cords in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
